name: Hindu Push-Up
steps: Start in an inverted V pike with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width, feet wide, hips high, and arms and legs straight.
Bend your elbows and swoop your chest forward and low just above the floor in a smooth diving arc.
Glide your chest past your hands, straighten your elbows and lift your breastbone as your hips lower.
Push back through your hands to raise your hips high again and return to the starting pike position.
tips: Flow smoothly through the entire arc while keeping your shoulders away from your ears at the upward arch.
Lengthen forward through your chest and limit the arch to a comfortable range.
